research_basis: Dashboards help monitoring, but this task is choosing a next lane.
Progressive disclosure works only when secondary information is genuinely secondary.
Task lists fit multi-step services, not a single next-lane decision.
Split-view and spine-detail patterns can keep decision and evidence visible together.
Card grids are suspect unless each card is a primary action and dependencies stay visible.

candidates.label: Split view: decision rail + evidence/preview pane
candidates.primary_strength: Keeps the active recommendation and the trust evidence visible at the same time without turning evidence into a closet.
candidates.primary_weakness: Needs responsive behavior so the right pane stacks cleanly on narrow screens.

candidates.label: Spine + detail: active path and selected node
candidates.primary_strength: Shows the route through hold, real input, and YMM4 observation without making every option equal.
candidates.primary_weakness: Can become process-heavy if the user only needs a simple current recommendation.

candidates.label: Start page / service entry + decision board
candidates.primary_strength: Strong explanation of purpose and first-time user orientation.
candidates.primary_weakness: Still tends to compare choices side by side and can slide back into card-board layout.

candidates.label: Wizard / step-by-step decision flow
candidates.primary_strength: Good for novice input gathering and exactly-one outcome.
candidates.primary_weakness: The weak-pass prototype showed that wizard language can over-trim evidence and hide trust checks.

candidates.label: Current card/drawer guided flow
candidates.primary_strength: Compact, local, dark, and already validates exactly-one recommendation.
candidates.primary_weakness: Cards make options look like equal objects, and the evidence drawer becomes a storage closet.

candidates.label: Command-center cockpit
candidates.primary_strength: Power users can scan many statuses quickly.
candidates.primary_weakness: It centers artifact inventory and repeats the original cockpit weakness for novice decision making.

decision: Implement a split-view decision rail plus evidence/preview pane next; do not keep extending the card/drawer guided flow.
test_strategy: evidence is available without becoming a junk drawer
